result.instructions: Tools for Paydirt, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my clients and their hourly rates."; "Log 90 minutes on the Website Build job for today."; "Show all unbilled time logs from last week.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Paydirt data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run paydirt_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run paydirt_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run paydirt_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. paydirt_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: paydirt_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List all clients of the account, with billing details and hourly rates. Paydirt API: GET /v1/clients.

tools.name: paydirt_get_client
tools.title: Get a client
tools.description: Get one client by id. Paydirt API: GET /v1/clients/{id}.

tools.name: paydirt_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Create a client with a business name. Paydirt API: POST /v1/clients.

tools.name: paydirt_update_client
tools.title: Update a client
tools.description: Change the business name of an existing client. Paydirt API: PUT /v1/clients/{id}.

tools.name: paydirt_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List all projects of the account, with their client and completion status. Paydirt API: GET /v1/projects.

tools.name: paydirt_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one project by id. Paydirt API: GET /v1/projects/{id}.

tools.name: paydirt_create_project
tools.title: Create a project
tools.description: Create a project under a client. Paydirt API: POST /v1/projects.

client_id.description: The client that owns the project id.

tools.name: paydirt_update_project
tools.title: Update a project
tools.description: Rename a project or mark it completed or open. Paydirt API: PUT /v1/projects/{id}.

tools.name: paydirt_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List all jobs of the account, with price, price type, estimate and completion. Paydirt API: GET /v1/jobs.

tools.name: paydirt_get_job
tools.title: Get a job
tools.description: Get one job by id. Paydirt API: GET /v1/jobs/{id}.

tools.name: paydirt_create_job
tools.title: Create a job
tools.description: Create a job in a project. price_type 0 = per hour at the job price, 1 = fixed price, 2 = per hour at each user's rate. Paydirt API: POST /v1/jobs.

project_id.description: The project that owns the job id.

price_type.description: 0 = per hour, 1 = fixed price, 2 = per hour at each user's rate.

price.description: The job price. Its meaning depends on price_type.

tools.name: paydirt_update_job
tools.title: Update a job
tools.description: Rename a job, move it to another project, or mark it completed or open. Paydirt API: PUT /v1/jobs/{id}.

project_id.description: The project the job moves to id.

tools.name: paydirt_list_time_logs
tools.title: List time logs
tools.description: List time logs, optionally filtered by date range, user, client, project, job, billable or billed status. Paydirt API: GET /v1/time.

start.description: Include logs on and after this date (inclusive).

end.description: Include logs up to and including this date.

billable.description: true = billable only, false = unbillable only.

billed.description: true = billed only, false = unbilled only.

tools.name: paydirt_get_time_log
tools.title: Get a time log
tools.description: Get one time log by id. Paydirt API: GET /v1/time/{id}.

tools.name: paydirt_create_time_log
tools.title: Log time
tools.description: Log time against a job. Give started_at and ended_at, or set duration_only true and give duration (seconds) and date. Defaults to the calling user. Creates a billable record. Paydirt API: POST /v1/time.

job_id.description: The job the time is logged against id.

user_id.description: The user who did the work (default: the calling user) id.

duration_only.description: true = log a duration on a date; false = log a start and end time.

duration.description: Duration in seconds. Required when duration_only is true.

date.description: Date of the log. Required when duration_only is true.

started_at.description: Start time. Required when duration_only is false.

ended_at.description: End time. Required when duration_only is false.

tools.name: paydirt_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the account (ids, names and emails). Use the ids for user_id filters. Paydirt API: GET /v1/users.
